name: 星辰·AI漫剧
desc: 星辰影院 AI漫剧 (v6 全局req)

js.home: const cate = env.get("category", "");const page = Number(env.get("page", 1) || 1);const base = env.baseUrl;const listUrl = page <= 1 ? (base + "/tv/47.html") : (base + "/tv/47/page/" + page + ".html");const html = await req(listUrl);const $ = kitty.load(html);const items = [];$("a").each(function () {const $a = $(this);const href = $a.attr("href") || "";const m = href.match(/^\/video\/(\d+)\.html$/);if (m) {const title = $a.attr("title") || $a.text().trim();if (title && items.length < 40) {const img = $a.find("img").first();const cover = img.attr("data-original") || img.attr("data-src") || img.attr("src") || "";if (!items.some(x => x.id === "/video/" + m[1] + "/")) items.push({ id: "/video/" + m[1] + "/", title, cover, remark: "AI漫剧" });}}});if (cate === "/") {return { type: "complex", data: [{ type: "card", title: "AI漫剧精选", videos: items }] };}return items;
js.detail: let id = env.get("movieId", "");if (!id) return { id: "", title: "", cover: "", playlist: [] };const m = String(id).match(/(\d+)/);if (m) id = m[1];const html = await req(env.baseUrl + "/video/" + id + ".html");const $ = kitty.load(html);let desc = $("meta[name=description]").attr("content") || "";desc = desc.replace(/^《[^》]*》免费高清版是一部来自于中国大陆的精品AI漫剧动漫.*?就在星辰影院[^.]*\./, "").replace(/^.*?免费播放完整版/, "").trim();let title = $("h1").text().trim();title = title.replace(/^漫剧《/, "").replace(/》.*$/, "");if (!title) title = ($("meta[property=og:title]").attr("content") || "").replace(/免费.*$/, "");let cover = "";$("img").each(function () {const src = $(this).attr("src") || "";if (!cover && (src.includes("uploads") || src.includes("/vod/") || src.includes("pic"))) cover = src;});const eps = [];$("a").each(function () {const $a = $(this);const href = $a.attr("href") || "";const em = href.match(/^\/play\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html$/);if (em && em[1] === String(id)) {const text = $a.text().trim();if (text) eps.push({ text, id: env.baseUrl + "/play/" + em[1] + "/" + em[2] + "/" + em[3] + ".html" });}});return { id: "/video/" + id + "/", title, cover, desc, remark: "AI漫剧", playlist: [{ title: "播放线路", videos: eps }] };
js.search: const wd = env.get("keyword", "");if (!wd) return [];const html = await req(env.baseUrl + "/search.php?keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(wd));const $ = kitty.load(html);const items = [];$("a").each(function () {const $a = $(this);const href = $a.attr("href") || "";const m = href.match(/^\/video\/(\d+)\.html$/);if (m) {const title = $a.attr("title") || $a.text().trim();if (title && items.length < 20) {const img = $a.find("img").first();const cover = img.attr("data-original") || img.attr("data-src") || img.attr("src") || "";if (!items.some(x => x.id === "/video/" + m[1] + "/")) items.push({ id: "/video/" + m[1] + "/", title, cover, remark: "" });}}});return items;
